body:
It should have configurable `--api-port` `--api-hostname`.

Instead of REST API it should implement: https://github.com/link-foundation/lino-rest-api

For now we should focus on "enqueue solve task" API route, that will allow for both /hive (and hive) commands as well as /solve (solve) to actually add to the queue, that we implemented earlier for hive-telegram-bot (solve queue), copy that logic, if it cannot be reused, or even better make sure we have .lib.mjs files to reuse the logic in both `hive-telegram-bot` and `orchestartor` command.

hive/solve/hive-telegram-bot commands all should have `--use-orchestrator hostname:port` configuration, from which we will by default use `/api/latest` or `/api/v0` version.

If https://github.com/link-foundation/lino-rest-api is not published or have missing features, just implement it in ./dependencies (in the root of repository as draft, that will be later migrated to https://github.com/link-foundation/lino-rest-api).

So the and result should be hive/solve/hive-telegram-bot command with `--use-orchestrator` will instead of executing solve commands directly will send API request to POST API route "enqueue solve task" in orchestrator, which will monitor resources (limits and so on) like we do now in hive-telegram-bot, and will manage the queues, and will execute agents without `--use-orchestrator` using solve command.

At the moment we will keep queue in both `hive-telegram-bot` and `orchestrator`, but once `orchestrator` is stable we will be able to decouple resource monitoring and queue management from  `hive-telegram-bot` to  `orchestrator`. That will allow to put `hive-telegram-bot`  on different server and control `orchestrator` remotely.

Also we should allow for `orchestrator` to be a balancer between other `orchestrator`s, meaning that instead of directly calling solve commands, it also can connect to other orchestrators and delegate a task to them. To be able to efficiently balance load, we should provide "task solving queue" GET api route, so `orchestrator` will provide `hive-telegram-bot` or other `orchestrators` with details on how loaded it is (like queue size). So in balancing mode `master` orchestrator will prefer to balance queue sizes on `slave` orchestrators.
title: Add orchestartor CLI command
